text: I'm in the middle of something right now. I'm very nervous because I'm doing a pitch on a stage and everyone's looking at me. They're all so nice to me. I think they want me to play with. I think they don't like my little product. But I'm joking, I know they do. You have some good feedbacks, but your pitch direction was looking at the question based on prior experience. I'm busy working on a new play song, and we're going to introduce some bands we put in recordings. Which we're going to put into play soon. I think you should record the recordings, videos and there's also a capital response for everything. We will put the recordings over Monday morning in Morningstar. And see your response and your prompt.
